errors.text: The hypothesis incorrectly makes deformation twinning and FCC-to-HCP transformation central deformation modes, whereas the target reports Shockley-partial slip and stacking faults without twinning or bulk phase transformation.

It replaces vacancy-cluster/disordered-atom nucleation sites with generic lattice-distortion sites and overstates thermal activation as the dominant cause of yield, missing the defect-specific nucleation mechanism.
The proposed strain-rate range of 10^-4 to 10^3 s^-1 does not reconstruct the molecular-dynamics regime of 10^8 to 10^10 s^-1 over which strain-rate-insensitive yield was observed.

Most cited evidence concerns Co-containing nanowires with free surfaces and size-dependent TWIP/TRIP behavior, not bulk periodic single-crystal FeNiCrMn, so it cannot establish the claimed mechanism in the target system.
